description: Pinned model checkpoints. Every file is fetched by exact revision and verified by size and SHA-256 before loading; inference never downloads. Licence evidence was read from the pinned sources on 2026-10-04.

models.name: depth_pro
models.role: Monocular metric depth prior for the strict photo and video tiers. Its metre output is a learned prior, never a sensor measurement. fp16 on accelerators: measured on the M2 Pro, fp32 needed 15.9 GiB of MPS memory and 53-168 s per image (swapping); fp16 needs 8.5 GiB and 6 s, differing from fp32 CPU by at most 0.28% per pixel on the smoke image.

weights_license.name: Apple Sample Code License (ASCL), per the official repository
evidence: Official README at commit 9e65e4d: 'The model weights are released under the [LICENSE](LICENSE) terms.' (the ASCL file above).
apple/DepthPro-hf model card body at revision de816c8: 'License: Apple-ASCL'.
apple/DepthPro-hf model card metadata tag at the same revision: 'license: apple-amlr' (Apple Machine Learning Research licence, research-use terms).
weights_license.note: The metadata conflict is unresolved. This non-commercial case-study use fits either reading; any commercial use needs Apple's terms confirmed first.

models.name: grounding_dino_tiny
models.role: Open-vocabulary box proposals for staged damage (stain, crack) and structural objects. Labels are hypotheses until calibrated (P19).

weights_license.name: Apache-2.0
evidence: IDEA-Research/grounding-dino-tiny model card metadata at revision a2bb814: 'license: apache-2.0'.
weights_license.note: Pretraining used third-party datasets (for example Objects365, GoldG); dataset terms are not restated by the checkpoint licence. The tokenizer files are BERT-base-uncased (Apache-2.0).

models.name: sam2_1_hiera_small
models.role: Promptable mask refinement for automatically proposed boxes. Not a damage classifier.

weights_license.name: Apache-2.0

facebook/sam2.1-hiera-small model card metadata at revision ee5bba1: 'license: apache-2.0'.
weights_license.note: Demo fonts (Inter, Noto Color Emoji) are SIL OFL-1.1; FloScan does not use the demo.
